title: Footnote Order And Reuse
note: Covers footnote numbering/collection in MarkdownChunker: a definition placed before its reference (a) and one placed after its reference (b), numbering assigned in first-reference order rather than definition order (b is referenced before a, even though a is defined first), the same footnote referenced twice sharing one number, a defined-but-never-referenced footnote that must not appear in the output, and a reference with no matching definition falling back to the literal [^label] text.
